files.README.md:
# Seedloft Community Seed Library - take-home handouts

Handouts live in handouts/, one file per handout day named
YYYY-MM-DD.txt. Each handout lists the varieties that are in stock
on the availability sheet in effect that day, one line each:

    - <variety> (<packets> packets)

in the sheet's row order. Rows whose note puts them on hold are
not handed out, so they stay off the handout. Only the sheet in
effect counts; older sheets are kept in prior/ for the archive.
